subject.title: fix(gateway): keep plugin approval title and description truncation UTF-16 safe

question: Should this PR be reset to the narrow gateway UTF-16 truncation fix, or should maintainers intentionally sponsor the broad unrelated branch contents as separate reviewed work?
rationale: The current head mixes a valid small bugfix with large unrelated maintainer-authored changes and a dirty merge state, so automation should not infer which changes are intentional to preserve or discard.

options.title: Reset to focused gateway fix
options.body: Keep only the node-invoke plugin approval truncation change plus its regression test, then refresh proof on the exact new head.

options.title: Split and sponsor the extra work
options.body: Move the Mantis workflow, app/protocol/provider/channel/docs/generated changes, and release-note edits to separate PRs with owners and proof for each surface.

options.title: Close and request a fresh PR
options.body: If the branch cannot be cleaned up cheaply, close this PR and ask for a new two-file gateway bugfix PR.

recommendation.title: Reset to focused gateway fix
recommendation.body: Keep only the node-invoke plugin approval truncation change plus its regression test, then refresh proof on the exact new head.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and authored the broad branch-expansion commits, so he is the best available owner for deciding whether to reset or split them.
